# Text To Leads Extractor

## What it does
Paste any job post, LinkedIn message, or outreach text. AI extracts recruiter emails, WhatsApp numbers, and Telegram handles — then generates a personalised outreach message with your CV attached, sent in one click.

## Features
- Connect Gmail, Outlook, or Yahoo — sends from your own email address via SMTP
- AI extracts emails, phone numbers, and Telegram usernames from any pasted text
- Automatically generates a personalised email with your name, skills, and experience
- Attaches your uploaded CV to every outreach email
- One-click WhatsApp and Telegram links with pre-filled message
- Upload your CV once — reused for every outreach session
- Fully self-hosted AI — your data never leaves the server

## How to use
1. Sign up at https://tools.zulqurnainj.com/auth/signup
2. Connect your email account (Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo) via SMTP settings
3. Upload your CV in the dashboard
4. Paste any job post or recruiter message into the text box
5. Click Extract — AI pulls all contact details
6. Send personalised email or open WhatsApp/Telegram with pre-filled message

## URL
